svg.title: Flare SM70 KV pool capacity
svg.desc: BF16 KV pool at memory limit 31G with 4 agents on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB: 98,304 tokens before replay-commit (2026-10-21, limited by memory); 131,584 tokens for the previous package fd7c24dc, the --kv-cache-limit concurrency cap; 124,928 tokens for package f21b9abb, limited by memory, because its 512-token prefill graphs take more memory (6,656 tokens or 5.1 % less). Four 28.7k-token prompts, 114,664 prompt tokens, fit in this package's pool; four 32,768-token contexts, 131,072 tokens, do not fit. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md, STATUS.md line 49.
